title: タンパク質工学
subtitle: Protein Engineering
educationalGoal: This course will provide students with knowledge of protein engineering. This course has two aims. The first is to teach students the basic of protein engineering. The second is to introduce the applications of protein engineering.
advice: This course will include the following topics: 1) Basic of protein engineering Protein conformation (amino acids, conformation, etc.) Purification (Protein extraction, protein purification, etc.) Enzyme (Reaction kinetics, coenzymes, inhibitors) 2) Application of protein engineering Strategies for protein overproduction Enzyme engineering
books: Textbooks:Essential Protein Engineering (Kodansha) Reference books:Genetic Engineering 2nd ed. Reserved books:Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: This course deals with the extension of the topics you learn in the “Basic Biology”, “Bioengineering” and “Gene Engineering” courses. Knowledge of nucleic acids and proteins is required.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the strategies for protein overproduction.
Ability to explain recombinant DNA technology.
